_comment: Development / SIPp-rig credential fixture for SIPD_CREDENTIAL_SOURCE=file.
Production resolves credentials over rpc.sip.v1.credential against apps/api; see
`realm` is the document-level default; an account may override it. Each account carries ONE of:
`password`  — converted to HA1 at load and then discarded;
`secretRef` — DERIVED with the shared provisioning contract from SIPD_PROVISION_SECRET_KEY,
so the fixture matches byte-for-byte what apps/api would have rendered for
orgId is the tenant that owns the AOR — it is what lands in the registrations KV key and in
every sip.reg.v1 event, so it must be a real organization UUID.
